title: 有馬記念の後に・Sweet Memories

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ohhhhh! Fine Motion!

text_block_list.name: Spectators A and B
text_block_list.text: Fiiiiine Motiooon! Sniffle… Yeeeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Everyone…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, I lost.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I'm really, really, really frustrated! …But I'm also a little happy.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Because I finally got to race against the real Fine!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Scarlet… Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: … Th-there's no need to thank me…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on your win! I have to go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone… I've finally reached it—this wonderful view.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: How do you feel? You better not say anything but "incredible."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Incredible! After an ending like this, I have no regrets.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Thought so. Makes sense that you'd be in high spirits since you won and all…

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: …I knew from the start how this would play out. I knew I'd lose here and that would be the end of the road for me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: But where's the fun in that? So I kept searching for something—anything that could change that result.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur…

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And that's when I found you, Fine. You were different. At first, all I cared about was getting some unique data and analyzing it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: But then, one day… you defied my predictions. In that moment, a thought crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: If anyone can change their fate, it's her.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I thought if I could get you to keep running—to defy your destiny—then that would prove that my fate could change as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: So I put my faith in a dumb hypothesis and clung to it… like an idiot.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And I ended up with the exact lame conclusion my data predicted. What a joke, right? Go ahead and laugh.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm not laughing. I know you still haven't given up, Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Even now, you're replaying today's race in your head, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You still want to win. You're a noble individual who can't allow yourself to remain beaten.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: There's no way you're finished. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And aren't you the same?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You still want to win, don't you? To run?! And despite that, you're just gonna run home?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Don't turn tail! Don't resign yourself to stepping down!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: …Prove it to me! Prove that any circumstances can be overcome!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Shakur. However, I'm afraid I have to leave all that to you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You've collected an abundance of data from me, right? That means I'll keep running within you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Keep running for me, Shakur. Win… and prove your theory.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: …Tch.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'm not doing anything for you. I already told you—everything is for my own sake.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Of course. …Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Damn, you really know how to piss me off…

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What did you think of the fervor here, princess?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It was incredible!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: …That so?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur… Farewell.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterward, we have a press conference to announce Fine Motion's return to Ireland.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm all right. …Hey, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm very fortunate, aren't I? I'm a truly, truly blessed individual.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I got to run so much, and I made so many friends. I heard the glorious sound of countless cheers.
choice_data_list: No one's going to forget the impact you've made.
No one's going to forget the impact you've made.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Right. I'm sure they'll all remember me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And I believe it'll be a dazzling memory.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Fine! Don't quit! Keep racing!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you all so much. However, I must bring these wonderful three years to a close.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: This exquisite ending has been decided from the very start.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Every race has a beginning and an end. But in our memories, it becomes more than a simple contest…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: As long as you none of you forget me, I'll live on in your memories.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: So please, allow me to stay… within your hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion's eyes glisten in rare fashion as she smiles on at the crowd.
